name: Can a handyman repair service install disability and accessibility modifications?

mainEntity.name: Can a handyman repair service install disability and accessibility modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, accessibility upgrades are a regular component of our handyman and home modification services. We install safety grab bars with solid structural blocking behind tile or drywall, widen interior doorways, replace standard door hardware with accessible levers, adjust threshold transitions to eliminate tripping hazards, and build interior access ramps. Because we handle framing and drywall repair in-house, we ensure wall framing is reinforced properly behind fixtures to support heavy weight loads, rather than relying on weak hollow-wall anchors that fail over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we install grab bars with reinforced wall blocking, widen doorways, adjust floor thresholds, and install accessible hardware throughout your home.
